beats.event: Walton finds Victor dying on the Arctic ice; Victor begins his tale
His mother Caroline dies of scarlet fever; Victor leaves for Ingolstadt
Obsessive study reveals to him a way to bestow life on dead matter
Victor animates the creature; is horrified by what he has made and flees
News from Geneva: his younger brother William has been murdered
Justine is tried and executed for the crime; Victor stays silent
On the Mer de Glace the creature demands his creator hear him out
Victor agrees to build the creature a female companion
In his Orkney lab Victor tears the half-finished female to pieces
The creature murders Henry Clerval in revenge on a Scottish shore
Victor marries his childhood love Elizabeth Lavenza
On the wedding night the creature strangles Elizabeth
Victor's father Alphonse dies of grief soon after
Victor pursues the creature across ice and snow to the Arctic
Victor dies on Walton's ship, still vowing vengeance
The creature boards, mourns Victor, and vanishes to burn himself on a pyre
